title: Sign in
heading: Sign in
intro: For the account your readings are kept with.
refused: Those details do not sign you in. If you bought a reading and have not chosen a password yet, ask for a link below and choose one now.
rateLimited: That is a few too many tries. Try again in {wait}.
rateLimitedBriefly: That is a few too many tries. Wait a moment and try once more.
unknownFailure: Something went wrong at our end. Try again in a moment.

forgot.heading: Ask for a link
forgot.intro: Type the address you bought with. If we have an account for it, a link to choose a password is on its way. It lasts an hour and works once.
forgot.sent: If we have an account for that address, a link is on its way. Look for it in the next few minutes.
forgot.invalidAddress: That does not look like an email address. Check it and try again.
forgot.rateLimited: That is a few too many asks. Try again in {wait}.
forgot.rateLimitedBriefly: That is a few too many asks. Wait a moment and try once more.
forgot.unknownFailure: Something went wrong at our end. No link has been sent. Try again in a moment.
